name: SelectableTag

props.name: defaultSelected
props.description: Specify the default state of the selectable tag.

props.name: renderIcon
props.description: A component used to render an icon.

props.name: selected
props.description: Specify the state of the selectable tag.

props.name: size
props.description: Specify the size of the Tag. Currently supports either `sm`, `md` (default) or `lg` sizes.

props.name: text
props.description: Provide text to be rendered inside of a the tag.

a11y.note: Carbon ships a11y behaviour per component; verify per screen

when_to_use: Use Carbon SelectableTag rather than building one.
when_not_to_use: Do not restyle off-token — propose a token instead.
